# Python fixture state

A small synthetic project state used by `tests/sdd-fixtures.sh` for its "Python fixture current
state" check and its two planted RED controls. It is not a real project and is never installed.
`targets/python/app` is the fixture root; `manual-ticket/IMPLEMENTATION.md` is the implementation
receipt the check reads two directories above it. Pass another root as argument 2 or through
`TASK06_PYTHON_FIXTURE` to check a different fixture.
